BHP Investment In Iron Ore Capacity
: BHP plans over $10 billion investment in iron ore through FY2028 to sustain and boost capacity, develop higher-grade ore and upgrade port and rail, targeting 305 million tonnes annual WA capacity.
Port Hedland Unions Reject Wage Offer
: BHP: Port Hedland unions rejected BHP’s wage offer after nine months. Unions will seek an intractable bargaining declaration and ask the Fair Work Commission to arbitrate a four-year iron ore deal.
BHP Seeks Fair Negotiations With Unions
